notes:
On the Serenity Desktop App's 1.12: her replies on Discord and Bluesky are no longer held back for sounding like something noted about someone.

- **No more echo check on her replies there.** Before, a reply that shared two telling words with anything noted about you or your people was held back with "it echoed something about someone you talk with". A reply that names someone you talk with is still held back (your own name is fine to your linked Discord account), and so is one with a link or a secret.
- Her free-time searches and notes keep the echo check.
